UFO filmmaker Jeremy Corbell returns to the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 1853 with new material. Corbell is known for releasing military videos of unknown objects and for his films on famous UFO cases. His visits keep the disclosure story moving on Rogan's show.

Corbell walks through the latest footage and whistleblower claims he has gathered. He argues the government knows far more about these craft than it admits. Rogan, a committed UFO watcher, tests the evidence and asks what comes next. Believers and sky-watchers get a fresh drop of claims to sort through and debate.
